PASS — performance review for pinned reference-membership developer tooling at Source `5fbebd9df3a60b6c29e09f7236c1b916fe4c4418`.

No blocking performance findings were identified in the accepted command scope. I independently reverified all 4,750 current Source entries (including symlink targets), the full semantic Git index, staged/untracked status and empty diffs against the actual test snapshot. The implementation file is 73,344 bytes, SHA-256 `80ff948cb850cd291f68afa25411362eb3b996f3fb6f8a5718213f556370e5c5`.

The command requires the exact immutable 16-file catalog: 141,571 original bytes total, largest 47,058 bytes. Only the two complete BUILD files (2,403 and 3,721 bytes) reach the lexer. Wrong original bytes fail length/hash verification first. Selection/source/total/output limits are 256 KiB / 4 MiB / 16 MiB / 16 MiB; token, delimiter-depth and top-level-call limits are 50,000 / 32 / 64. Checked arithmetic prevents count overflow, and the depth limit also bounds literal recursion. Borrowed token slices, finite deterministic containers, fixed protocol-witness scans and RAII file ownership are reasonable for this fixed input set. No repository-wide recursion or subprocess/background work occurs in the implementation.

Output encoding finishes in a checked, fallible bounded writer before publication opens a file. Creation uses `create_new`; check mode performs a bounded full-byte comparison without writes. Input/output budget and lexical-depth/token/call/source regressions passed. A filesystem write error can leave a newly created partial file and returns an error; this is not a transactional-publication guarantee.

Actual normal locked owner validation passed: 136 xtask tests, including all 22 membership regressions, with zero failures, ignores or filtered cases; Fresh:false artifacts point to the current worktree. Build, repository Clippy and full formatting receipts passed. The compiled CLI completed all ten expected-result cases, with a 53,129-byte output (SHA-256 `1e55ecb3bbe9273483795d66a349a97043bb870e6cdcf191adc113b09bba7596`). Create/check stage durations were approximately 0.216/0.204 seconds; these include owner source-guard overhead and are observations, not benchmark guarantees. Every receipt and raw log hash is bound in the companion JSON.

This PASS depends on the fixed pinned catalog. The lexer rescans a line's indentation prefix for each token, which can become superlinear for adversarial generalized inputs. Such altered contents are rejected before parsing here; widening accepted inputs needs a separate algorithm/performance review. Peak RSS, CPU profiling, IDE startup, UI responsiveness, large Android projects and device/upstream-runner performance remain unmeasured. Full app/current workspace CI and final integration guards remain lead gates.

No Cargo, compiler, CLI, SDK or app was run by this reviewer; no Source, Git or shared-cache mutation occurred. Only these external review reports were written. Original behavior credit remains zero, upstream runtime-case counts null, applicability unresolved and global census false. Read hold released.
